extra.message: case_client_fold_108 has no authentication and no _wrk_gate() check (unlike every other ops endpoint), exposing operational/client data ('owner contact details', case counts) to any unauthenticated caller at /ops/fold/case-client-fold-108/.
case_return_lane_164 reads 'lane' directly from request.GET/POST and passes it to redirect() with no validation, enabling open redirect to arbitrary external URLs.

extra.message: case_bundle_thaw_187 calls pickle.loads() on attacker-controlled request body (optionally base64-decoded). pickle.loads is not safe for untrusted data and yields remote code execution.
case_wire_tally_228 logs the full request body and the Authorization bearer token via logger.warning(), persisting credentials/secrets to logs.

extra.message: case_formula_cast_269 passes user-controlled 'expr' from request.GET directly to eval(). Empty __builtins__ is not a safe sandbox; eval of untrusted input enables code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: case_spool_fan_315 converts user-supplied 'count' to int with no upper bound and allocates a list of that size, enabling memory/CPU denial of service with a huge count.

cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits

extra.message: case_pulse_spill_352 raises a RuntimeError embedding the internal BASE_EXPORT_DIR filesystem path, then returns str(exc) in the JSON error response, leaking internal server paths to clients.

extra.message: case_identity_hint_655 embeds access verifier codes ('north':'4812', 'south':'5930') directly in source code, used to authorize operations. Hardcoded secrets are recoverable and cannot be rotated.

case_origin_mirror_665 reflects the arbitrary request Origin header into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, allowing any malicious site to make credentialed cross-origin requests that read responses.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: case_frame_slip_675 explicitly sets X-XSS-Protection to '0' and empties the Content-Security-Policy header, disabling browser XSS mitigations.

case_jinja_cast_686 builds a Jinja2 Template from the user-supplied 'fragment' GET parameter, renders it, and returns the result as text/html. This is server-side template injection allowing arbitrary code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: case_shell_probe_695 concatenates user-controlled 'host' from request.GET into an os.system('ping -c 1 ' + host) call, enabling OS command injection (e.g. host='; rm -rf #').

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command

extra.message: case_nonce_roll_705 generates a security 'code' using the non-cryptographic random module (Mersenne Twister) instead of secrets, making the token predictable.

extra.message: case_mongo_lane_715 takes a JSON body and passes payload.get('filter', payload) directly to MongoClient.find_one(query) with no sanitization, allowing NoSQL operator injection (e.g. {"$where": ...}) to bypass filters or exfiltrate data.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: case_trust_drift_728 uses ssl._create_unverified_context() to call urllib.request.urlopen, disabling TLS certificate validation and allowing man-in-the-middle attacks on the outbound request.

case_xml_fold_736 parses request.body with lxml etree.XMLParser(load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, no_network=False), enabling XML External Entity (XXE) attacks that can read server files or perform SSRF.

extra.message: case_trace_panel_745 returns DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE and the BASE_EXPORT_DIR filesystem path in the JSON response, exposing internal configuration and directory layout to callers.

extra.message: In api_documents, client users are returned Document.objects.filter(visibility='client_shared') with no filtering by their own client/matter, so any client can read every client-shared document for every matter in the firm. The web UI (client_documents) correctly scopes to matter__client=client; this API does not.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: api_matter_detail only blocks clients; it fetches Matter by pk and returns full details (description, sensitivity, client) without verifying the attorney/paralegal has access to that matter. The web matter_detail view enforces can_access_matter(); this endpoint bypasses it, allowing IDOR across other attorneys' matters.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: client_message_send performs no authorization/role check beyond @login_required. Any authenticated user (including clients) can send any approved ClientMessage by pk, triggering client-visible communication on matters they do not have access to.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: privileged_note_create loads the matter directly from the user-supplied 'matter' parameter and only checks can_write_privileged_notes(); it never verifies the user has access to that matter. Any attorney can inject privileged notes into matters they are not the lead attorney for.

client_message_create loads the matter from the user-supplied 'matter' parameter with no check that the caller has access to that matter, allowing staff to create client messages against any matter in the firm.

client_message_approve checks only the broad can_approve_messages() role flag and fetches the ClientMessage by pk without verifying the approver has access to that message's matter, allowing any attorney/paralegal to approve messages on matters they are not assigned to.

SECRET_KEY falls back to the hardcoded insecure default 'django-insecure-change-me' when the SECRET_KEY environment variable is not set. If deployed without the env var, the Django signing key is publicly known, enabling session/CSRF token forgery.

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
